'''Zalor Minister''',<ref name="GB" /> also referred to as '''Zalorian Minister''',<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> was a title for government officials on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]]<ref name="GB" /> in the [[Zaloriis system/Legends|Zaloriis system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Zaloriis system/Legends|Zaloriis system]]</ref> during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|rule]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GB" /> Multiple ministers held the position at a [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="Prima" /> and were responsible for paying Imperial tributes, although they were not informed of the testing of secret weapons such as the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] on the planet.<ref name="GB" />

The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zalorian/Legends|Zalorian]] [[Transe Decar]] was a Zalor Minister shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In that time, Decar and the population of Zaloriis [[Zalorian Separatists|defected]] to the Rebellion, attracting the attention of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] after Zaloriis's [[Standard month/Legends|monthly]] tribute was left unpaid. Vader met Decar on Zaloriis, where the minister revealed the defection and tried to ambush Vader with a group of [[Zalor Militiaman|Zalor Militiamen]]. However, Vader [[Death/Legends|slew]] Decar and [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|crushed]] the Rebel uprising.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Zalorian Minister was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing as Zalor Minister in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> In the game, the title is usually given as "Minister," but the full title is provided in the reconnaissance report of the level "An Empire's Fury," as well as in the game's credits and captions, where Transe Decar was credited as Zalor Minister.<ref name="GB" />
